scope: Retrospective incremental utility pilot, not a prospective or general antigen-screening validation. Existing 2026-10-21 SPR mean-dynamics negative results are known and will be disclosed.
primary_dataset: All 93 designed peptides per system in public HERMES All-designs.xlsx: NYESO/1G4, EBV/TK3, MAGE/engineered TCR; 279 candidates. Exclude only two WT controls and unstimulated control per system, never filter failed designs.
primary_endpoint: Author-provided functional response resp or resp_el4; do not call it direct binding or affinity.
structure_recipe: Uniform fixed experimental reference backbone for all candidates per system; sequence replacement and removal of changed residue sidechain atoms only. Primary PDBs 2BNQ,3MV7,5BRZ; secondary 2BNR,4PRP,5BS0. These are hypothetical poses, not experimentally determined mutant structures or relaxed mutant conformations.
FlexPPI: Frozen current 2430-record all-chain family fold0 full epoch40. No base-model retraining; source and weights exactly as verified in bcr_model_screen_20261028. Intrachain branch retained as sensitivity.
binding_baselines: Official ERGO-II McPAS and VDJdb, plus official NetTCR2.2 uniform pan. Select NetTCR checkpoint subset only from known pair training overlap partitions, before new predictions, never from performance. Also retain raw baseline scores.

downstream_models.B0: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=1, penalty=l2, solver=lbfgs, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=2000), using 3 baseline binding scores.
downstream_models.B1: Same classifier plus published TCRdock PAE, AF3 interface PAE, two published NetMHCpan binder indicators, minimum Hamming distance to WT.
downstream_models.B2: Same classifier plus 8 FlexPPI features: WT-normalized regional mean RMSF and Hchi for alpha CDR3, beta CDR3, alpha CDR1+CDR2, beta CDR1+CDR2; IMGT definitions fixed via ANARCII. Only unchanged receptor residues, exclude A/G from Hchi.
downstream_models.controls: B1 plus within-system row-permuted dynamic vectors, seeds 0..199, same 8 dimensions and identical fitting; intrachain dynamics and 2 secondary templates as sensitivity. No selection of best seed, region or template.

preprocessing: Training-only scaling and median imputation, with missing-value indicators if any; no use of response magnitude, original design model identifier or author predicted-positive flag as model feature.
primary_split: Leave entire TCR/system out: train on two systems, predict all 93 candidates of third; three held-out predictions concatenated. No random row split as primary.
secondary_split: Within each system, group peptide sequences into connected components at Hamming distance <=2; use group-held-out folds if each training split has both labels. Report cluster sizes and failures; no fallback to shuffled candidate split.
primary_metrics: True functional positives among top10 per held-out system, macro average precision (PR-AUC summary using average_precision_score), AUROC descriptive; exact candidate rankings and false negatives retained. Continuous response Spearman secondary.
claims: Only three independent systems. No residue/structure seed inflation, no confirmatory p-value from 279 IID assumption, no treating correlated templates as new biological samples. Gains must be reported by system and sensitivity; otherwise no stable screening benefit claim.
overlap: Audit FlexPPI complete input chains vs actual current 3063-record pool and released baseline training lists. Disclose potential homology/training overlap; do not call strict zero-shot if not excluded.
stopping: Run fixed comparison, retain negative results, do not search new regions/hyperparameters to force gains. Manuscript unchanged.
